parity.scope: Every candidate score on every original supplied test query, same CPU/chunking. Equal score bits guarantee identical deterministic rankings; no approximation.

gate.policy: Proceed only if seed-0 engineered beats raw validation NDCG@20 and retains >=97.5% of frozen BundleFuse validation R@20 and NDCG@20 on BOTH datasets. Feasibility threshold, not equivalence.

selected.policy: Per-arm seed-0 full-validation NDCG@20 selects learning rate; seeds 1/2 repeat that rate with validation checkpoints. No test selection; no teacher or sparse-input augmentation.

features.limitation: Fixed 256-column input budget; engineering may lose information under compression. No claim about every feature representation or rank.

timing.scope: One-thread CPU; 32-query warm batches, three repeats; full catalogue scoring. Ranking/metric cost separate; external embedding extraction excluded. RSS is whole-worker.
